items.title: Jim Cramer Says the AI Slowdown Is Fake. Dell Is His Evidence.
items.summary: Jim Cramer built his case that AI spending fears are overblown on three stocks, but two of them moved in the exact wrong direction on the day he made the call.

items.title: Should You Buy Qualcomm Stock For The Cash As Apple Leaves?
items.summary: Qualcomm (QCOM) throws off free cash worth 5.2% of its market value each year, against 4.4% for the median S&P 500 company. A yield above the median means one of two things: a bargain or a business the market expects to shrink. Here it is mostly the second: the cash comes from smartphone chips, and Apple is leaving.

items.title: How Far Can NVIDIA Stock Fall In A Demand Scare?
items.summary: NVIDIA (NVDA) stock trades near $212, about 10% below its 52-week high, and it has gone nowhere over the past three months. The company itself has not been standing still. So it is worth asking the uncomfortable question: how far does a stock like this fall when a real shock arrives, and how long would you wait to get it back.

items.title: Hock Tan Just Guided Broadcom's AI Revenue to Reach $230 Billion by 2028. Should You Believe Him?
items.summary: Broadcom's previous ambitious guidance turned out to underestimate its AI chip growth.

items.title: OpenAI’s CFO Just Explained Why Nvidia Is No Longer the Only Option
items.summary: OpenAI's CFO just revealed how $122 billion in cash fundamentally changes the power dynamic between the world's most important AI lab and its chip suppliers, and the implications for Nvidia's premium pricing are only beginning to surface.

items.title: Broadcom (AVGO) Shares Fell As Slower AI Development Raised Demand Concerns
items.summary: Broadcom (NasdaqGS:AVGO) shares were caught in a sector-wide pullback after AI leaders urged slower development of advanced models. Anthropic's CEO published a high-profile essay calling for a pause on rapidly scaling AI systems, citing safety and ethical risks. OpenAI's CEO echoed similar caution, which prompted investors to reassess longer term demand assumptions for AI chips and infrastructure suppliers. items.title: Broadcom CEO delivers blunt verdict on AI’s biggest debate right now
items.summary: AI’s potential benefits are enormous, but so are the consequences.

items.title: This AI Stock Could Be Worth Far More Than Investors Think
items.summary: Broadcom just posted AI revenue growth of 221% year over year and guided for even bigger numbers ahead, yet the stock sits well off its highs and trades at a fraction of its closest custom-chip rival's multiple. Something in that math does not add up.
